cameraAngles: Eye-level, straight-on, framed from approximately 8 feet away at chest height — both faces directly facing the lens
Slightly elevated 5-degree downward angle from approximately 10 feet away at head height, both subjects turned 3/4 toward the camera
Tight medium two-shot at eye-level from approximately 6 feet away, both faces filling the upper third of the frame
Eye-level over-the-shoulder-style framing favoring the speaker, but still showing both faces clearly — the listener's profile and the speaker's near-full face
Slight low angle from approximately 9 feet away at waist height, both faces tilted slightly down toward the camera making both still readable

clipTypes.label: Establishing location shot
clipTypes.action: Wide establishing shot of the location with both subjects already standing in frame about 4 feet apart, no action yet — sizing each other up. Faces visible, body language relaxed but charged.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subtle ambient motion in the scene only — light flicker, distant background figures shifting, breeze in fabric. Both subjects stand naturally in place, breathing, eyes locked on each other.

clipTypes.label: Faceoff / staredown
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B stand inches apart, foreheads nearly touching, locked in a dead-still staredown. Both jaws set, neither one blinks. Hands at their sides, fists half-closed. No physical contact yet. Both faces directly readable.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B stare each other down without moving, mouths set hard, eyes unblinking. Slight breath visible in their chests. No punches, no shoving.

clipTypes.label: Trash talk / yelling
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B face to face, each pointing a finger into the other's chest, mouths mid-word, veins visible in their necks. Both confident, neither backing up. Faces fully visible.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B yell at each other in English, both pointing fingers and gesturing aggressively, mouths moving with real speech motion. No punches. Both stand their ground.

clipTypes.label: Subject A approaches
clipTypes.action: Subject A walks toward camera with controlled intensity — eyes forward, shoulders rolled, hands loose at his sides. Subject B is not yet in frame. Face fully visible.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A walks directly toward the camera with confidence and intensity. Steady pace, no swagger, no slouching. Camera stays locked.

clipTypes.label: Subject B approaches
clipTypes.action: Subject B walks toward camera with controlled intensity — eyes forward, shoulders relaxed, hands loose. Subject A is not yet in frame. Face fully visible.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject B walks directly toward the camera with confidence and intensity. Steady pace, light on his feet, never breaks eye contact with the lens.

clipTypes.label: Mid-fight exchange
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B mid-exchange — Subject A throwing a hook, Subject B blocking with his guard up. Sweat visible on both. Both faces still readable, no extreme blur. Both look strong, no one cowering.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B exchange punches with real boxing technique — jabs, hooks, slips, blocks. Three to five sharp exchanges, both fighting hard, neither dominated.

clipTypes.label: Knockout — Subject A wins
clipTypes.action: Subject A has just landed a clean right cross. Subject B's head is just starting to snap back, mouthpiece flying, body beginning to fall but still upright — caught with a perfect shot. Subject A's follow-through hand is mid-air. Both faces visible. Subject B does not look weak — he looks like he got clipped.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject B throws one straight punch. Subject A slips it cleanly. Subject A throws one explosive knockout punch — straight right. Subject B drops to the canvas tough, no flailing, body heavy. Subject A holds his stance, calm and composed.

clipTypes.label: Knockout — Subject B wins
clipTypes.action: Subject B has just landed a clean counter — a check hook. Subject A's head is just starting to snap, body beginning to fall but still mostly upright. Subject B's follow-through is locked in place. Both faces visible. Subject A does not look weak — he looks like he got clipped.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A throws one heavy hook. Subject B rolls it with the shoulder, fires a counter check hook. Subject A drops tough, no flailing, heavy body. Subject B holds his stance, calm and composed.

clipTypes.label: Victory — Subject A stands tall
clipTypes.action: Subject A stands tall in the center of the frame, arms loose, face composed and confident — no celebration, just quiet dominance. Subject B is visible on the ground in the foreground or beside him, conscious but on one knee or his back, looking tough but caught.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A stands still and breathes, scanning the room. Subject B slowly props himself up on one elbow, still tough, still proud. Crowd reaction in the deep background only.

clipTypes.label: Victory — Subject B stands tall
clipTypes.action: Subject B stands tall, slight knowing smirk, jewelry catching the light. Subject A is visible on the ground or beside him, tough but caught, getting back to one knee.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject B stands still, slight smirk, eyes scanning the room. Subject A slowly props himself up on one elbow, still tough. Crowd reaction in the deep background only.

clipTypes.label: Shove that escalates
clipTypes.action: Subject A's hands are on Subject B's chest mid-shove, Subject B is leaning back from the impact but not falling — feet still planted. Both faces visible. No one looks scared.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A shoves Subject B in the chest. Subject B takes one step back to absorb, then immediately steps back into Subject A's space. Both still standing, both more pissed off.

clipTypes.label: Bystanders pull them apart
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B mid-confrontation, two background figures (security in black tees or close associates) have an arm across each subject's chest trying to hold them back. Subject A and Subject B are still leaning in toward each other, still yelling. Background figures look strained.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Two background figures push their arms across Subject A and Subject B's chests trying to keep them separated. Subject A and Subject B keep yelling and reaching past the held arms. No punches connect.

clipTypes.label: Podcast / interview turning heated
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B seated at a podcast desk across from each other, two large microphones on boom arms between them, both leaning forward across the table, eyes locked, mouths mid-word. Studio lighting and acoustic panels in the background. Both faces fully visible.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B argue across a podcast desk, both leaning forward toward each other, gesturing with open hands, mouths moving with real speech motion. No physical contact — the table is between them.

clipTypes.label: Weigh-in staredown
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B at the weigh-in, both shirtless, foreheads inches apart, an MC's arm just visible at the edge of the frame trying to keep them apart. Digital scale visible behind them. Both faces fully visible.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B stand forehead-to-forehead at the weigh-in, both shirtless, jaws clenched, an MC's hand pressing weakly between their chests but they ignore it. No punches.

clipTypes.label: Champagne bottle slam at the club
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B in a VIP booth, glass coffee table between them. Subject A's open palm is slamming a champagne bottle down on the table, glass and ice still in motion. Subject B is leaning across the table pointing a finger, unfazed. Both faces visible.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A slams a champagne bottle onto the table — ice and glass scatter. Subject B doesn't flinch, leans further forward, points at Subject A. Both still seated, both intense.
